metadata.accuracy: coordinates approximate to the facility, not surveyed

properties.name: Świnoujście LNG
properties.note: Poland's first LNG import terminal and the anchor of its move off Russian pipeline gas.

properties.name: Klaipėda FSRU
properties.note: The floating terminal that ended Lithuania's single-supplier dependence, in service since 2014.

properties.name: Wilhelmshaven LNG
properties.note: Germany's first import terminal, stood up in months over the winter of 2022–23.

properties.name: Gate terminal, Rotterdam
properties.note: One of north-west Europe's main import and reload hubs.

properties.name: Zeebrugge LNG
properties.note: Import and transshipment terminal, historically a reload point for Russian Arctic cargoes.

properties.name: Sines LNG
properties.note: Iberia's Atlantic import point; the peninsula's weak pipeline links to France limit how much reaches the rest of the EU.

properties.name: Revithoussa LNG
properties.note: Greek import terminal feeding the Balkan interconnectors.

properties.name: Alexandroupolis FSRU
properties.note: Northern Greek terminal built to push gas north into Bulgaria and beyond.

properties.name: Inkoo FSRU
properties.note: Finland's chartered floating terminal, commissioned after Russian pipeline supply was cut in 2022.

properties.name: Yamal LNG, Sabetta
properties.note: Russia's flagship Arctic LNG plant and port on the Ob Gulf, shipping east along the Northern Sea Route in summer and west year-round.

properties.name: Schwedt refinery
properties.note: Supplies much of Berlin and eastern Germany; converted from Druzhba crude to seaborne imports via Rostock and Gdańsk.

properties.name: Ryazan refinery
properties.note: One of Russia's largest, and a recurring target of long-range Ukrainian drone strikes.

properties.name: Volgograd refinery
properties.note: Southern Russian processing hub within reach of Ukrainian deep strikes.

properties.name: Kirishi refinery
properties.note: North-western Russia's main refinery, feeding the Baltic export terminals.

properties.name: Tuapse refinery
properties.note: Black Sea coast refinery and export terminal.

properties.name: Omsk refinery
properties.note: Russia's largest by capacity, deep in Siberia and far from the front.

properties.name: Primorsk oil terminal
properties.note: The main Baltic crude export outlet and a key loading point for the shadow tanker fleet.

properties.name: Novorossiysk oil terminal
properties.note: Black Sea export hub, including the outlet for the Caspian Pipeline Consortium carrying Kazakh crude.
